items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: We played at Black Labley College in the United States. We played with George.

ctx.x: That's a well named. We played at Black Labley College in the United States. We played with George. And we, Chicago, Wisconsin, Frisco, Los Angeles, Beverly, I mean Brooklyn, played a college there, Oxford, Indiana, New York, oh many others. Columbia's Ohio, or Cleaver. So you've been around.
Oh yeah, I've been around. I've been around. Something that always interested me, I think you must listen to records more than most musicians.

items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: going across the front of the stage was George Lewis, uh... Kid Howard, and Jim Robinson.

ctx.x: Could you describe the setup at the... this was at the Beverly Capitol? Mm-hmm. The setup there, the atmosphere, clientele, prices, the way the band was received, general atmosphere of the... of the club and so on.

It was strictly at over 21 places. Strictly cocktail, there was a little Chinese restaurant next door. Um... As you looked at the stage, the... they had a grand piano for Purnell. And he... as you looked at the... well... as you looked at the stage, he was on the right. The banjo was just in front of him, slightly to the left. And then going across the front of the stage was George Lewis, uh... Kid Howard, and Jim Robinson. Directly in the center behind the band, it was kind of... it was in a corner. You had the…
Uh... what about the, um... was there any dancing?

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Yeah, I have one in there, I use it with George's band.

ctx.x: They don't play with that. I'm thinking about the Morgan band again. Somebody told me they used to use the slap sticks that Sam and some of them might have
been. Yeah, I have one in there, I use it with George's band. Really?
I never saw anybody do it with George's band. No. Kid Thomas does it over across the river.
